jobs.title: Tax Advisor
jobs.desc:
Our Company
McAvoy & Associates is a consulting firm providing clients with expertise in taxation, business advisory, and accounting services. Founded in 1997, the firm has built a strong reputation for high-quality, partner-led service and a focus on innovative, client-driven solutions.
We have led the field in Ireland in terms of academic research and authored the most authoritative commentary on income tax in Ireland, “McAvoy & Associates: Irish Income Tax”.
The firm serves a diverse client base and is committed to building long-term relationships as its clients’ trusted advisors.
Our team works closely with each of our clients to understand their individual requirements and to deliver comprehensive advice tailored to their needs.
Your Role as a Tax Advisor
One of the things that sets our firm apart from others is that we will not pigeon-hole you into a narrow field from which your development as an expert tax advisor is constrained.
You will be part of a collaborative partner-led team in which you will be encouraged to work and advise across the entire range of Irish taxes. This breadth not only keeps your work stimulating but also means that our clients will benefit from comprehensive tax advice that will come from a single point of contact.
The Type of Work You Will Do
The work that our tax team does involves:
Providing tax advisory and compliance services to a wide range of corporate and private clients.
Preparing and reviewing position papers and tax returns.
Interpreting relevant tax law and analysing tax issues.
Assisting with tax audits.
Drafting commentary on tax matters for issue to clients and inclusion on the firm’s website.
Your Development
You will find that we are fully committed to your training and development. You will have access to a comprehensive programme of knowledge and skills training, as well as individual support and guidance.
With almost 30 years of success as an independent firm of expert advisors, we will offer you the opportunity to deepen your technical knowledge, accelerate your professional development and reach the highest rungs of the firm.
What we are looking for
A qualified accountant with a good academic background, having graduated from university with a grade of at least 2:1.
A career-minded individual who wishes to achieve their full potential as a tax advisor. You may already have acquired the Chartered Tax Advisor qualification, but if not, this will not affect your application in any way. Indeed, our preference usually is to admit candidates who will and study for the CTA qualification while working with us.
A person who enjoys working in a collaborative team in which fresh ideas and interesting projects are always present.
Someone who wants to be a problem-solver and is ever-curious on matters of tax law.
The Location
This is a full-time role based on-site in the heart of Cork city.
The Benefits
We offer a market-leading salary , generous pension and a parking spot close to the office In addition, if you are studying for the CTA qualification we will pay for both your CTA study course and your exam fees.
The interview process
Our recruitment process is straightforward and usually involves at least two separate interviews with one or two of our partners.
Our interviews are informal and relaxed, and we use them to allow you to perform to the best of your ability and to give you the opportunity to ask questions.

How the hiring process works:
If your skills and experience align with our expectations, a member of our Talent team will reach out via email to begin an initial screening. This stage allows us to understand your experience and expectations while giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role and our company. If successful, we will outline the full interview process, which may include a combination of remote and on-site interviews. Depending on the role, a task or presentation may also be part of the process. Throughout, we aim to ensure a positive and transparent candidate experience, keeping you informed at each stage.
Responsibilities
Prospecting & Lead Generation
Identify and research target markets, industries, and companies across Ireland.
Use cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, and networking to reach potential clients.
Qualify inbound leads generated through marketing campaigns.
Client Engagement
Conduct discovery calls to understand prospective clients’ IT and business challenges.
Effectively communicate our value proposition and solutions to decision-makers.
Schedule and coordinate meetings or demos for the field sales team.
Pipeline Management
Maintain accurate records of all activities in the CRM.
Track and report weekly on leads generated, meetings booked, and conversion rates.
Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to refine outreach strategies.
Market Awareness
Stay updated on trends in the cybersecurity market.
Monitor competitor offerings and highlight differentiators in client conversations.
Skills & Qualifications
Essential:
Proven track record in sales, business development, or lead generation - preferably in IT or cybersecurity sector.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Confident in making cold calls and engaging with C-level executives.
Experience using CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot).
Desirable:
Knowledge of cybersecurity and managed services solutions.
Familiarity with the Irish business landscape and SME/enterprise markets.
Diversity & Inclusion Mission Statement
At Smarttech247, our mission is to keep our customers secure. Cybersecurity is a complex industry, therefore, in order to tackle its challenges and continue to innovate, we believe that a diverse workforce contributes to greater collective intelligence and ultimately, makes a stronger team – qualities that are needed in our fight against cybercrime.
Smarttech247 is proud to be committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive
jobs.desc:
Business Development Executive (EU Pilot Lines)
About Tyndall
Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).
Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.
The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.
With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.
Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.
About the Team
You will join a dynamic team of innovation and industry engagement leaders with global experience, who are business partners to Tyndall’s 25 research groups and semiconductor fab facility. The team works closely with each group to advance their emerging technologies in alignment with technology roadmaps and validated industry needs, to establish mutually beneficial industry partnerships with Irish and global partners, and to create scalable startup companies.
You will work closely with other business functions, such as Legal and Finance, and government agency partners, such as IDA and EI, to ensure that our engagement models are best in class and that we establish international partnerships across the EU, US and Asia that deliver economic impact and growth.
About the Role
Tyndall is a partner in three of the Chips JU funded pilot lines, each designed to drive innovation in advanced semiconductor technologies and support European technological sovereignty.
NanoIC Pilot Line - A €1.4bn public investment across 6 partners developing beyond 2nm leading-edge SoC pilot line for advanced logic, memory and interconnect technologies for markets like computing, communication, mobility, energy and health
FAMES Pilot Line – A €0.8bn investment across 11 partners focused on the development of new chip architectures for microcontrollers, microprocessor units, chips for 5G/6G, smart imagers, smart sensors, processors for data fusion, wearable devices, trusted chips, quantum and cryoCMOS, edge AI chip and advanced packaging with chiplets.
PIXEurope Pilot Line - €0.4bn investment across 20 partners advancing next-generation Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) technologies through an open access ecosystem.
As Tyndall’s Pilot Line Business Development Executive, you will play a critical role in catalyzing industry engagement with the pilot line activities in Tyndall. This is a new transformative role, where you will work closely with the EU Pilot Line teams in Tyndall to develop and implement novel industry engagement models to aid the transfer of technology into industry and market deployment. This will include working with pilot line partners across Europe to establish a cohesive network and effective industry engagement platform.
Reporting to Tyndall’s Director of Innovation & Industry Engagement, you will be a member of the Innovation & Industry Engagement Directorate, where you will also support the wider Tyndall Innovation objectives, as detailed in the recently launched Tyndall 2030 strategy. This includes developing and driving collaborative industry partner acquisition, securing industry income, IP commercialisation, and spin-out creation.
Key Duties & Responsibilities
Develop and implement industry engagement strategies and partnership models which underpin Tyndall’s participation in the NanoIC, FAMES, and PIXEurope pilot lines.
Identify, develop, and secure collaborative projects with industry partners by working closely with Pilot Line teams, leading the full contract lifecycle from opportunity development through negotiation and execution.
Secure industry income which contributes to the commercial and strategic objectives of both the pilot lines and Tyndall.
Collaborate with internal departments to achieve successful customer proposals.
Build and expand relationships with semiconductor and semiconductor-enabled companies across Ireland, Europe, and international markets.
Collaborate with Pilot Line teams to clarify partner requirements, align expectations and timelines, and define project scope and deliverables in conjunction with research teams.
Develop strategic programmes, partnerships, and consortia that support the long-term sustainability and growth of the pilot lines and Tyndall beyond the current funding period.
Shape targeted sector and international engagement strategies, working closely with Enterprise Ireland and the IDA to attract new companies and access emerging markets.
Represent Tyndall and its pilot line programmes at national and international conferences, trade shows, and industry events.
Organise, host and represent Tyndall at high-level industry engagements, including executive visits, stakeholder meetings, and strategic events.
Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective customers, partners, and strategic opportunities.
Develop market and commercial intelligence, monitor trends, conduct market research, provide insights and recommendations for implementation.
Prepare regular reports and forecasts against approved objectives, outlining performance, opportunities, customer feedback.
Leadership/mentorship –impart commercial expertise, knowledge, promote a customer focused culture.
Participate in Education and Public Engagement activities.
Ensure compliance with Tyndall’s Quality Management Systems, Health and Safety standards, and other regulations.
Other duties as assigned by the Director of Innovation & Industry Engagement when required.
Essential Criteria
A BSc in engineering or equivalent degree (preferably MSc and or MBA).
Typically 6+ years’ experience in business development, or related activities, in the semiconductor and semiconductor enabled sectors.
Knowledge of the semiconductor value chain and ecosystem sector and trends, including the context of the EU Chips Act and industrial research and development.
Proven track record of successfully negotiating and executing high-value commercial contracts and collaborative agreements.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills, including strong presentation skills.
Highly motivated and adaptable, with the flexibility and willingness to undertake national and international travel.
Record of working independently and also working closely with others to maintain a positive and collaborative environment, in particular during challenging projects.
Expe

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations and Total Rewards
jobs.desc:
Role Overview
Based in our Cork office, this role sits at the intersection of people operations and total rewards, with global scope and genuine ownership. You will manage the systems, processes, and programmes that underpin how we attract, retain, and reward our people worldwide bringing operational rigour and strategic thinking in equal measure.
You will work closely with HR leadership, Finance, and Legal, acting as a trusted partner to HRBPs and business leaders globally. You will play a central role in driving the AI-enabled transformation of the People function - identifying opportunities to automate workflows, augment decision-making, and redesign how the team operates day to day using emerging AI tools and capabilities.
Responsibilities
People Operations
Lead the AI transformation of People Operations evaluating, piloting, and embedding AI tools across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and policy management to compensation modelling and people analytics, and building the team's capability to work effectively alongside AI.
Own and continuously improve global HR operations including HRIS (UKG) administration, data integrity, process documentation, and AI-enabled workflow automation - ensuring a seamless employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle.
Manage and evolve HR policies globally, ensuring compliance with local employment law across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining consistency in global people practices.
Build and maintain people analytics reporting to support data-driven decisions by HR leadership and business partners.
Own the People team's technology stack, working closely with IT and Data teams to integrate systems, safeguard data, and unlock new capabilities.
Manage and develop a small global team, setting priorities and building capability across time zones.
Total Rewards
Lead the design, administration, and communication of global compensation programmes - including salary structures, bonus plans, and equity ensuring they are competitive, equitable, and aligned to business strategy.
Own and evolve the benefits portfolio with responsibility for managing vendor relationships, renewals, and regional programme design. As the company continues to grow, this role will play a key part in extending our benefits offering into additional regions ensuring local market norms and regulatory requirements are met at every stage.
Drive the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end, from market benchmarking and budget modelling to manager guidance and employee communications.
Conduct and interpret compensation benchmarking surveys (Radford) to keep pay ranges current and defensible, and advise on offer competitiveness and internal equity.
Lead pay equity analysis and gender pay gap reporting.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful depth in both people operations and compensation and/or benefits.
Proficiency with HRIS platforms (UKG, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent) and strong analytical skills - comfortable building models and presenting data-driven recommendations.
Total compensation design and strategy experience, including salary structures, bonus plans, equity (RSUs, stock options), and benefits with the ability to architect, communicate, and govern total reward frameworks in a global, multi-jurisdiction environment.
Technology or hardware industry is preferred, with familiarity with the compensation structures, equity programmes, and talent dynamics typical of a global tech environment.

Lead and develop the maintenance team, fostering a strong people management culture and technical capability

Drive continuous improvement initiatives and embed Lean principles across maintenance processes
Develop and implement strategies for engineering execution and asset life-cycle management

Guarantee compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements, particularly regarding hazardous materials

Degree in Engineering or a relevant trade qualification
Proven experience in a process-driven industry, with practical application of continuous improvement and Lean methodologies (food, pharmaceutical, or medical devices preferred)
Strong leadership, communication and people management skills with a hands-on approach
Good problem-solving ability and engineering mindset
Practical application of engineering principles in operational settings
Solid business acumen and ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing teams
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 28 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,700 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.
Get in touch today!
At Kinisla, we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.

We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.
Job Summary
The Educator role is the foundation of our success as an organization. Educators are experts in creating world-class customer service, or guest experience, in our retail stores. They are responsible for engaging and connecting with our guests, sharing top-quality product education, and speaking authentically about our community and culture.
Key Responsibilities Of The Job
Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience
Interact with guests to ensure a great guest experience in a manner that values guests’ time.
Assess guests’ needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.
Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.
Facilitate a seamless end-to-end guest experience by conducting accurate and timely guest transactions and executing market-relevant omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options) according to company standards.
Move dynamically on the floor to continuously engage with guests and attend to guest or store needs.
Receive guest feedback and partner with store leadership to take appropriate action and “make it right” for guests.
Working With Others
Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.
Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.
Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations.
Operations
Perform product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards.
Use in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences.
Perform cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store.
Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment.
Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations.
Key Skills & Core Values You Bring
Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences
Integrity/Honesty: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner
Guest Experience: Enjoys working and connecting with, understanding, and helping guests
Personal Responsibility: Accepts responsibility/accountability for actions; is dependable
Self-Awareness: Is aware of how words or actions may be perceived by or affect others
Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with others to achieve goals; seeks diverse perspectives
Enthusiasm: Is enthusiastic about one’s own work; looks for ways to make work fun and engaging
Job Requirements
Eligibility
Must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the store is located
Must be 18 years of age or older
Must have proof of the Right to Work and evidence relating to associated local legislative requirements (EMEA only)
Must have the ability to travel to assigned store with own transportation methods
Availability
Willing to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays
Other Willingness Requirements
Willing to work in an environment with bright lights and loud music
Willing to move through a store for most of a shift to help guests and accomplish work
Willing to move boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg)
Willing to work as part of a team and also complete some work independently
Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)
Education: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
In keeping with our mission, please connect with us at accommodations@lululemon.com if you have questions about how your unique abilities may translate to the requirements for this role, with or without a reasonable accommodation. In your email, please include the position title, the location of the position and the nature of your question or request.
Beyond The Paycheck (Benefits & Perks)
At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person – body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. In addition to competitive base pay and a team-based bonus program, we also offer extended health plans, paid time off, savings plans, generous employee discounts, fitness/yoga classes, parenthood top up program and personal and professional development programs.
Note: availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to your location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these benefits and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

jobs.title: Principal Industrial Designer
jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
Principal Industrial Designer - Mouse Design Team : Cork, Ireland
Hybrid role - base 3 days a week on site*
THE ROLE
Logitech is seeking a Principal Industrial Designer to join our Mouse Design Team in Cork. This is a senior-level position for a recognised expert who balances world-class craft with strategic foresight — a thinker and a doer. You will work on complex design assignments, solving unique challenges that have a broad impact on our product portfolio and the future direction of our businesses.
Based in our Cork office, you will be a key member of a team dedicated to excellence in handheld products, leading the creation of mice that are as comfortable, ergonomically superior as they are visually groundbreaking.
WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT FOR LOGITECH?
The mouse is at the core of Logitech's product portfolio. We design the tools people reach for every day - products where form, material, ergonomics, and engineering precision must coexist seamlessly and where world class design quality is non-negotiable. At the Principal level, you will be shaping the future of one of our most competitive and scrutinised product categories. We prototype to learn, design to inspire, and ship real products that people enthuse about and love to use.
YOUR CONTRIBUTION
Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change.
Visionary Craft & Innovation: Lead the design and development of future-forward mouse experiences, transforming complex human problems into polished, intuitive, and beautiful design solutions.
Strategic Influence: Partner with senior leadership to shape the long-term direction of the Mouse Design Team, ensuring design strategy aligns with emerging trends and business objectives.
Design Excellence: Manage key design processes and projects from brief through to production builds, maintaining an unrelenting focus on quality, detail, and creative confidence.
Mentorship & Leadership: Provide guidance and thought leadership to the broader design team. Mentor other designers and foster a culture of curiosity and exceptional craftsmanship.
Collaborative Networking: Build strong relationships with engineering, product marketing, and business stakeholders to drive design quality and change across a multidisciplinary environment.
Key Qualifications
To be considered, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviours to our team:
Proven Track Record: 10+ years of relevant experience in Industrial Design, either in-house or at a leading agency, with a portfolio of successful, high-volume consumer hardware products.
Physical-Digital Mastery: Exceptional hands-on skills in sketching, visualisation, and physical prototyping (including hand-sculpting in foam). Deep understanding of anthropometrics, ergonomics, and the iterative digital-to-physical workflow required for handheld devices.
3D CAD Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in surface CAD - excellent working knowledge of Rhino, SolidWorks, Alias, Fusion or Creo Parametric, Class-A surfacing principles and experience exchanging high-quality 3D files with mechanical engineers and CAD specialists.
CMF & Manufacturing: Working expertise in Materials, Colours and Finishes, Design for Manufacturing, and EVT/DVT/PVT build processes — you understand how to maintain design intent through engineering development.
AI Proficiency: Comfortable integrating AI tools (e.g., Vizcom, Gemini, Magnific) into ideation and concept visualisation workflows. Able to move faster and explore more broadly because of it - not instead of core craft.
Communication & Storytelling: Able to craft compelling design narratives and present persuasively to stakeholders at all levels, from engineers to senior executives.
Highly driven, collaborative, and a proactive self-starter — you take on ambiguous assignments and drive them through to valuable outcomes.
Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Design, Product Design, or a related field.
OUR CULTURE
At Logitech, we act like a small company. We believe that anyone can have the best idea. We value designers who are humble, hungry, and brave enough to challenge conventional thinking — and we offer a highly collaborative, international environment where your work will impact millions of people worldwide.
Logitech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Logitech are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Responsibilities
This role will support the delivery, integration and sustainment of Operational Technology systems across PGCS sites globally, with a strong focus on AVEVA-based platforms and MES-enabled manufacturing. Support the delivery of MES batching projects from an automation and OT integration perspective.
Ensure Digital Factory initiatives have the required automation data points, connectivity and contextualisation to enable reliable MES ↔ Automation communication.
Configure, deploy and sustain AVEVA System Platform, OMI, InTouch and InBatch solutions across multiple sites.
Develop and maintain integration mechanisms between PLCs, System Platform and MES layers, including SQL-based data handling and validation.
Support global migration, standardisation and template strategy for AVEVA System Platform implementations.
Work closely with system integrators and vendors to ensure solutions align with PGCS OT standards and cybersecurity requirements.
Provide technical governance to ensure projects comply with PepsiCo automation specifications, GAMP principles and industry best practice.
Contribute to OT cybersecurity readiness, including secure architecture, patching strategies and access control alignment with corporate standards.
Support incident management, troubleshooting and lifecycle sustainment of OT platforms across global sites.
Assist in developing and maintaining OT standards, documentation and approved design patterns.
Deliver knowledge transfer and technical training to site teams to ensure successful operational handover.
Engage collaboratively with global stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Digital Factory and Supply Chain functions.
Standardisation & Training
Ensure all OT implementations follow PGCS global automation standards and approved design frameworks.
Drive consistency in System Platform configuration, deployment models and integration approaches across sites.
Provide technical training and mentoring to site engineering teams to support adoption and sustainment of deployed solutions.
Support development of reusable templates, documentation and best practices for global rollout.
Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with: AVEVA System Platform
AVEVA OMI
AVEVA InTouch
AVEVA InBatch
AVEVA MES integrations
Experience using SQL within industrial environments for data management and troubleshooting.
Proven experience delivering OT / automation solutions within manufacturing environments.
Experience managing system integrators and automation vendors.
Understanding of OT cybersecurity principles and secure industrial architectures.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computer Science or related discipline.
Typically 5 to 10 years’ experience in a similar industrial role.
Experience working within GAMP or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
Strong stakeholder engagement, documentation and communication skills.
Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
Typically 5 to 10 years’ experience in industrial automation or OT roles.
Experience working within regulated or GAMP-aligned environments preferred.
Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder engagement skills.
Additional Qualifications And/or Experience
Experience supporting global digital transformation programmes.
Exposure to standardisation of plant models, templates and multi-site architectures.
Familiarity with lifecycle management and sustainment of OT platforms at scale.
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated more than $79 billion in net revenue in 2021, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. Role Overview
This is a hybrid role based in our Cork office.
As a Staff Engineer on NETGEAR’s AI Platform and Enablement team, you will play a strategic and highly impactful role in shaping how AI is built into the fabric of the whole company: engineering teams, business units and corporate functions alike. This position is designed for a deeply experienced technical leader who thrives at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer enablement and business enablement.
You will own three interconnected areas of ownership. First, you will help build and operate the core AI and LLM platform: model routing, evaluation, and the shared tooling that lets teams across NETGEAR build reliably on top of large language models. Second, you will scale the use of coding agents and assistants across engineering, raising AI fluency and the bar on how we ship software. Third, and equally important, you will extend AI enablement beyond engineering and into business functions — finding the workflows worth automating and building them.
That third mandate is not a side project. A meaningful share of NETGEAR’s near-term AI value sits in business process, not product code, and this role is expected to have organisation-wide impact. Much of the work will resemble the enablement currently being driven for non-technical teams, scaled up and made repeatable.
With significant autonomy, you will own delivery of key technical initiatives aligned with organisational goals and directly influence the short and medium-term success of NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Key Responsibilities
AI and LLM Platform Infrastructure
Design, build, and operate the shared AI platform layer: model routing and fallback strategies, API gateway patterns, rate limiting, and multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others as needed).
Own cost and usage optimisation across the organisation’s AI spend, covering model selection, prompt and context efficiency, caching, and session-level cost controls.
Build evaluation, observability, and monitoring for LLM-powered features and agents, including quality regression detection and usage analytics.
Define architecture and standards for secure, scalable integration of AI capabilities into product and internal systems, including authentication, data handling, and compliance considerations.
Engineering AI Enablement
Drive adoption and effective use of AI coding agents and assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across engineering teams.
Build internal tooling, guardrails, and workflows (agentic SDLC patterns, managed agents, review and QA processes) that let engineers safely delegate more work to AI.
Establish best practices, documentation, and training that raise the AI fluency of the wider engineering organisation.
Business and Functional Enablement
Partner directly with business units and corporate functions (Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, People, Legal) to identify high-value AI opportunities in their day-to-day work.
Sit with functional teams, map how their processes actually run today, and simplify before automating: strip out steps that exist only for historical reasons rather than encoding them into an agent.
Design and deliver AI solutions for non-technical users, including skills, agents, connectors and internal applications that people without an engineering background can adopt and trust.
Build the enablement layer that makes this repeatable: reusable patterns, templates, onboarding material, office hours, and a community of practice across functions.
Translate fluently in both directions - turning business problems into technical designs and explaining technical constraints and risks in language a functional leader can act on.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration
Reporting directly to the AI Platform Engineering Director, working with cross-functional teams to align technical execution with NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Own delivery of end-to-end initiatives that bridge platform infrastructure, developer tooling, business process and product engineering.
Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and system debugging across multiple layers of the platform.
Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers and functional champions working with AI tools and platform services, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and responsible AI use.
Establish and track clear objectives, delivering measurable results aligned with quarterly goals and reporting on AI-driven productivity gains and cost efficiency across the organisation.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated history of leading impactful technical initiatives.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) in production, including prompt and context design, tool use, and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated ability to simplify complexity: taking a tangled business flow or legacy process, understanding it end to end, and reducing it to something clear, reliable and automatable. A track record of continuously exploring new tools and techniques in a fast-moving field.
Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to deliver technology that they adopt and keep using.
Strong track record of cost, performance, and reliability optimisation in cloud or distributed systems, with a proven ability to influence business outcomes through technology decisions.
Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, APIs, or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and a genuine interest in scaling their use across an organisation.
Strong design and architectural skills, including experience with distributed systems, observability, and secure API design.
Proficiency in one or more of: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages used for platform and tooling development.
Demonstrated experience defining and delivering on a platform or enablement strategy, not just individual features.
Strong communicator, able to articulate technical direction to both technical and non-technical audiences and comfortable presenting to functional leadership.
Experience with agent frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or similar tool-orchestration approaches.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in business process automation, RPA, workflow tooling or systems integration across enterprise applications (for example ERP, CRM, finance or supply chain systems).
Expertise with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automation (for example GitHub Actions) applied to AI and ML workflows.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native architectures.
Background in data or ML engineering, evaluation frameworks, or LLMOps.
Experience working across mobile, web, or embedded systems and understanding how AI integrates with each.

jobs.title: Project Engineer / Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.desc:
About the Role:
Join us at Ferrero Cork as a RDM (Project Engineer / Continuous Improvement Engineer), where you will take ownership of leading site performance improvement, maintenance excellence, asset optimization, and strategic operational initiatives. Working closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners, you will lead initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, asset performance, and cost competitiveness. The RDM will play a critical role in improving plant performance by driving reliability, operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and capital project delivery across the site.
This role is responsible for developing and executing improvement strategies, leading cross functional projects, optimizing maintenance systems and processes, supporting capital investments, and delivering measurable business results. Acting as a key partner to operational teams, you will ensure sustainable improvements and long term value creation across the facility.
Main Responsibilities:
At the Core of the RDM role lies Asset Performance & Maintenance Excellence. A key part of your role will be to develop and implement strategies to improve equipment performance, uptime, and overall plant efficiency while driving maintenance excellence through the optimization of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. You will lead initiatives aimed at improving OEE, reducing downtime, and eliminating recurring equipment failures. The RDM is responsible for monitoring and analysing maintenance and operational KPIs to identify opportunities for improvement while supporting maintenance planning and scheduling processes to maximise resource utilisation and asset availability. Ensuring maintenance activities are aligned with business objectives, safety standards, and operational requirements you will promote best practices in asset management, maintenance systems, and equipment lifecycle management.
A key part of this role is Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence. You will lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, reliability, and cost performance while facilitating structured problem solving and root cause analysis activities to address operational challenges. You will drive TPM, Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and loss elimination programs across the site, analysing operational data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and optimise processes. Developing and implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions will form a key part of your remit. You will support business case development and ROI evaluations for improvement projects. You will champion a culture of continuous improvement and accountability across all departments.
Projects & Capital Investment will sit at the heart of your role. You will lead and coordinate operational and technical projects from concept through execution and completion while developing project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies. Managing capital projects, equipment upgrades, installations, and process improvement initiatives, you will coordinate cross functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. You will monitor project performance to ensure objectives are achieved within scope, budget, and schedule while supporting equipment commissioning, validation, and handover activities. In addition, you’ll ensure all projects deliver measurable business benefits and sustainable operational improvements.
You will play an integral part in Stakeholder & Contractor Management, building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across all site functions. Coordinating contractors, suppliers, service providers, and engineering partners, you will develop project scopes and support contractor selection and procurement activities. This role is responsible for monitoring contractor performance and ensuring deliverables meet agreed expectations, while ensuring contractors comply with site safety, quality, GMP, and operational standards. In addition, you will provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and performance to site leadership.
As the RDM you will take ownership of Governance, Compliance & Reporting. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate records relating to maintenance, projects, asset performance, and improvement activities, while ensuring compliance with company standards, GMP requirements, food safety systems, environmental regulations, and health and safety legislation. You will support internal and external audits, inspections, and compliance programs. Finally, this role is responsible for the development and maintenance of performance dashboards and reports to support data driven decision making while contributing to the development and standardisation of maintenance, project management, and operational excellence processes.
About You:
You will bring a relevant 3rd level qualification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Operations Management, or Food Science. Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, or operational environment would be highly advantageous, as would experience delivering operational improvements and business performance results while leading cross functional teams and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
The ideal candidate will have experience in project management, capital expenditure projects, and technical improvement initiatives and is self motivated with a strong focus on execution, accountability, and results. Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and asset management principles are key.
What We Offer:
Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.
About Ferrero:
Ferrero began its journey in the small town of
Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946.
Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many
iconic brands
sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.
DE&I at Ferrero:
Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.

Learn how we process your data in our Privacy Policy.
To help us review applications fairly and efficiently, we use a system that automatically checks and decides how well each application matches the role.
This system looks at your answers to a few screening questions. These questions were created by the system and reviewed by the JYSK Talent Acquisition team, and each question and answer have a certain value. Based on your answers, the system ranks all candidates to give us an idea of how closely the job fits your profile.
This helps us manage all applications and make sure everyone is treated equally. The result from the system decides if your application moves forward to the next step. But don’t worry — the final decision is always made by a person.
If you’d like to know more about how we process your personal data and your rights, please check our Privacy Policy.

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Job Title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
Location: Munich, Cork, Katowice, Edinburgh
Reports to:
Senior Principal Engineer
The Role
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Digital Design Engineer to join the Performance Solutions Group (PSG).
The candidate will contribute to the development of complex, high-performance semiconductor designs.
You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, developing and integrating RTL for advanced SoCs and silicon platforms. You will be involved throughout the front-end design process, from understanding architectural requirements and developing microarchitectures through RTL implementation, simulation, synthesis, and handoff to downstream teams.
This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, learning new technologies, and working across the boundaries between architecture, RTL, verification, and physical implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and integrate high-quality synthesizable RTL using SystemVerilog.
Translate architectural specifications into robust, efficient microarchitectures and RTL implementations.
Work with architects and senior engineers to understand functional and performance requirements.
Develop RTL that meets requirements for performance, power, area, and functionality.
Participate in RTL design reviews and contribute to design methodology and coding standards.
Develop and maintain unit-level and block-level test environments in collaboration with verification engineers.
Debug functional issues using simulation, waveform analysis, assertions, and other verification tools.
Work with verification teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve RTL design issues.
Collaborate with physical design engineers to understand and address timing, area, power, and implementation constraints.
Support synthesis, timing analysis, linting, CDC analysis, and other front-end quality checks.
Contribute to integration of internally developed and third-party IP.
Help investigate and resolve issues encountered during integration and downstream implementation.
Document design decisions, interfaces, microarchitecture, implementation details and reviews within the PSG Quality Management System (QMS)
Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL methodologies, automation, and development flows.
Work alongside senior engineers to develop solutions to challenging customer and internal silicon problems.
Technical Scope
Depending On Experience, The Role May Encompass Areas Including
SystemVerilog RTL
SoC and subsystem design
CPU, GPU, AI/ML, networking, or other high-performance compute architectures
Control logic and datapaths
Memory interfaces and controllers
High-speed interfaces
Clock and reset architectures
AMBA protocols such as AXI, AHB, and APB
IP integration
Low-power design techniques
Assertions and formal verification
RTL synthesis and optimization
Static analysis, lint, and CDC
Performance and power optimization
RTL-to-gates implementation flows
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of relevant RTL/ASIC design experience.
Proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog.
Understanding of digital logic design and synchronous design principles.
Experience developing synthesizable RTL for ASIC or FPGA implementations.
Familiarity with simulation and RTL debugging.
Understanding of common SoC interfaces and protocols.
Basic understanding of synthesis, timing, and physical implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Ability to communicate effectively to customers
What Success Looks Like
Deliver robust RTL. Develop clean, maintainable, synthesizable RTL that meets functional and performance requirements.
Think beyond the RTL. Understand how design decisions affect verification, synthesis, timing, power, area, and ultimately silicon.
Solve problems independently. Take ownership of assigned blocks and issues while knowing when to seek guidance from more senior engineers.
Work collaboratively. Build strong working relationships with architects, verification, physical design, and other Silicon Engineering teams.
Learn quickly. Develop expertise in new architectures, technologies, methodologies, and Cadence tools as projects evolve.
Grow into technical leadership. Develop the depth and breadth needed to take ownership of increasingly complex blocks and eventually lead technical areas within the Silicon Engineering organisation.
Why Join the PSG Team?
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technology, EDA, and real silicon.
You will work on problems that are often at the limits of what current design methodologies and technologies can achieve, collaborating with some of the world's leading semiconductor companies and technology partners.
Rather than being limited to a single product or stage of the design flow, you will have the opportunity to influence the entire path from technology and methodology through to working silicon.
If you are an engineer who wants to solve the industry's hardest silicon problems—and see those solutions become real products—this is the team for you.
Additional Information
Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Travel:
<10%
We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

Chartered or working towards Chartership (e.g., with the Geological Society or CIWEM)

jobs.title: Staff Mixed-Signal Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Staff Mixed Signal Design Engineer
About The Role
As a Staff Mixed Signal Design Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in the design and development of sophisticated mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs) including power management ICs, ADCs, DACs, PLLs, and other mixed-signal blocks. You'll make critical architectural decisions, drive technical innovation, and establish mixed-signal design methodologies.
Your expertise will bridge both analog and digital domains, enabling you to optimize system performance while mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance semiconductor solutions.
Job Duties And Responsibilities
As a Staff Mixed-Signal Design Engineer within the Advanced Cores Group (ACG) you will work on the development of ADC, DAC, and/or SerDes PHY subsystems for highly sophisticated mixed-signal system-on-chip (SoC) integrated circuit products using FinFET wafer technologies. The Advanced Cores Group develops innovative, state of the art, high-performance circuits as often shown by presentations at premier conferences and publications in premier journals. Your work will include:
Evaluating alternative mixed-signal subsystem implementation architectures.
Designing challenging transistor-level mixed-signal integrated circuits.
Preparing effective design documents and conduct effective design reviews.
Guiding mixed-signal integrated circuit layout.
Guiding mixed-signal integrated circuit evaluation and test.
Qualifications
MS Electrical Engineering.
7+ years of mixed-signal integrated circuit development experience.
Strong understanding of data converter architectures and specifications and/or deep understanding of SerDes PHY architectures and specifications
Deep understanding of mixed-signal design fundamentals, design tools, and methodologies.
Solid understanding of integrated circuit product development, including design, verification, evaluation, test, and qualification.
Successful experience developing challenging mixed-signal integrated circuits for commercial applications.
Strong technical leadership, teamwork, and communication skills.
Why You’ll Love Working at ADI
At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world.
Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you’ll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.
The Role:
We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end user journey for Aiven's self-serve customer base. This role is deeply focused on what happens after someone signs up — turning new users into activated ones, activated users into paying customers, and paying customers into expanded accounts.
You'll combine segmentation, behavioural data, and personalised messaging to build a lifecycle program that drives measurable monetisation outcomes. This includes everything from in-console nudges to nurture flows to expansion signals.
What You'll Do:
Own the full user lifecycle from sign-up through activation, conversion, retention, and expansion
Design and execute nurture programs tailored to where users are in their journey — onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and milestone-based triggers
Build and manage in-console messaging and product nudges in partnership with Product — surfacing the right prompt to the right user at the right moment
Develop and maintain user segmentation frameworks based on product usage, firmographics, and behavioural signals
Drive monetisation programs: identifying users with high conversion or expansion potential and delivering targeted interventions (upgrade prompts, usage-based triggers, tier nudges)
Work closely with Product and Data teams to define the signals that indicate activation, health, and churn risk — and build automated responses to them
Own lifecycle reporting: activation rates, conversion rates, expansion revenue influenced, and churn metrics
What We're Looking For:
Proven experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, ideally at a SaaS or PLG company
Deep understanding of user journey mapping and funnel-based thinking
You're highly data-driven, you can build a cohort, read a funnel, and turn behavioural signals into a clear hypothesis worth testing.
Experience with marketing automation and lifecycle tooling (e.g. Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or similar)
Familiarity with in-product messaging tools (e.g. Intercom, Pendo, or similar) is a strong plus
Strong collaboration skills, this role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Data
Amazing! What’s next:
If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!
AI Usage:
Aiven does not use AI to screen and/or select applicants. However, you will have the opportunity to demonstrate your AI proficiency during the live challenge stage of our interview process.
Global Benefits:
Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:
Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast. (BitQuery DB)
How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:
There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.
Equal Opportunities:
Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. Aiven complies with applicable local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, training and any other terms and conditions related to employment.
At Aiven we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or special needs in our working environment and job application procedures. We make all reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities or who otherwise need support to thrive in the workplace. We are committed to continuously improving workplace accessibility. There is an option to request a discussion in the application process but if you have any questions before applying please write to us at recruitment@aiven.io.
